Who Was Charlie Kirk? Net Worth, Controversies, Personal Life Of Donald Trump's Ally Shot Dead At 31
Charlie Kirk, the outspoken conservative activist and founder of Turning Point USA, was shot and killed on September 10, 2025, while speaking at Utah Valley University.
Advertisement
The 31-year-old American right-wing political activist, Charlie Kirk, was shot dead on September 10. The tragedy took place when he attended an outdoor campus event at Utah Valley University. Kirk was an outspoken ally of Donald Trump, and his death has been dubbed a ‘political assassination’ by many. He was also the CEO and co-founder of the conservative youth organisation Turning Point USA.
Charlie Kirk's background and personal life
Born on October 14, 1993, in Arlington Heights, Illinois, Kirk developed an interest in politics at a young age. He briefly attended Harper College before leaving to pursue activism full-time. In 2021, he married Erika Frantzve, a former Miss Arizona and entrepreneur. The political activist is a father of two - a girl born in 2022 and a boy in 2024. Kirk often spoke publicly about his Christian faith and family life, framing them as central to his worldview.
Charlie Kirk co-founded TP USA at just 18
In 2012, at just 18, Kirk co-founded Turning Point USA (TPUSA), a nonprofit organisation aimed at mobilising young conservatives on college campuses. Under his leadership, TPUSA grew rapidly, establishing hundreds of chapters across the country. Over the years, Kirk became one of the key players in the pro-Trump network and became largely known for his ‘Make America Great Again’ advocacy. The President of the USA, Donald Trump, has often credited him for bringing in youth supporters for the Republican Party in the 2024 election. His close alignment with Trump elevated his profile, but also drew criticism from opponents who accused him of spreading divisive rhetoric.
Apart from direct political activism, Kirk also hosted The Charlie Kirk Show, a daily talk program that combined political commentary with cultural debates. His provocative style invited criticism and praise alike. His show became another avenue to amplify his views on culture, politics, and current events. He boasts 8.4 million followers on Instagram.

Charlie Kirk's life in the limelight was not free of controversy
Kirk’s rapid rise was not without turbulence. His company, TPUSA, drew criticism for initiatives like the Professor Watchlist, accused of intimidating academics. Financial scrutiny also followed, with reports questioning how his salary and personal assets grew alongside TPUSA’s expansion.
His rhetoric often attracted backlash, especially from opposition members. He opposed COVID-19 vaccine mandates and spread unfounded claims about election fraud, fueling criticism that he amplified misinformation. He also made headlines for inflammatory remarks on immigration, LGBTQ+ rights, and race-related debates.

Charlie Kirk's wealth and assets
By 2025, Kirk’s estimated net worth stood at $12 million. He drew income from his role at TPUSA, podcasting, speaking fees, and book royalties. He owned multiple luxury properties, including a multimillion-dollar estate in Scottsdale, Arizona, and a condominium in Florida.
Charli Kirk's untimely death
On September 10, Kirk was speaking at a debate hosted by Turning Point USA at Utah Valley University when authorities said the shooter fired from a roof. Videos posted to social media show Kirk speaking into a handheld microphone while sitting under a white tent. A single shot rings out and Kirk reaches up with his right hand as blood gushes from the left side of his neck.
The news of his death was first shared by Trump on Truth Social. In an emotional post, the President described Kirk as "The Great, and even Legendary," praising him for understanding "the heart of the youth in the United States of America." Trump wrote, "No one understood or had the heart of the youth in the United States of America better than Charlie. He was loved and admired by ALL, especially me, and now he is no longer with us. Melania and my sympathies go out to his beautiful wife, Erika, and his family. Charlie, we love you!"
